people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: You yourselves testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before him.’
translations.bsb: You yourselves can testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ, but am sent ahead of Him.’
translations.kjv: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.
translations.asv: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but, that I am sent before him.
